subject: Spec: Hint reveal state machine (audit doc, no change needed)
body:
## Purpose
This spec documents the current hint reveal implementation as a state machine. No code changes needed. Filed to create a permanent spec record for future reference and design QA.

## Current Implementation (verified exam.html)

### State Machine: Hint Reveal

States:
- HIDDEN: Hint container not shown. No hint layers visible.
- L1_VISIBLE: Layer 1 (hint text) shown. 'Show Answer' button visible.
- L2_VISIBLE: Layers 1+2 (hint + worked example) shown. 'Solution Steps' button visible.
- L3_VISIBLE: All 3 layers shown. No more expand buttons.
- AUTO_RESCUED: Hint auto-shown after 3 wrong attempts. All layers and buttons visible immediately.

Transitions:
- HIDDEN -> L1_VISIBLE: User clicks hint button
- L1_VISIBLE -> L2_VISIBLE: User clicks 'Show Answer'
- L2_VISIBLE -> L3_VISIBLE: User clicks 'Solution Steps'
- Any state -> AUTO_RESCUED: 3rd wrong attempt triggers triggerRescue()
- AUTO_RESCUED: terminal state per question (no un-rescue)

## Visual Spec

### HIDDEN
- [Hint] button visible, hint container hidden (display:none or opacity:0)

### L1_VISIBLE
- Hint text shown
- [Show Answer] button appears
- [Hint] button: aria-expanded='true'

### L2_VISIBLE
- Hint text + worked example shown
- [Solution Steps] button appears

### L3_VISIBLE
- All 3 layers shown
- No more expand buttons
- Hint button: stays visible (for reference)

### AUTO_RESCUED
- All 3 layers visible immediately
- Feedback copy: 'Off target. Check the hint below.' (MCM-approved)
- All expand buttons shown (user can choose entry point)
- No animation on auto-reveal (ADHD: sudden rescue should be calm, not alarming)

## Gaps Found (not blocking, P3/low)
1. aria-expanded not confirmed on hint button -- should toggle between 'false' (HIDDEN) and 'true' (L1+ states)
2. No aria-live announcement when AUTO_RESCUED fires -- Kai's screen reader won't know rescue happened

## Acceptance Criteria (gaps only)
1. hint button: aria-expanded='false' when HIDDEN, aria-expanded='true' when L1+
2. On AUTO_RESCUED: aria-live='polite' region announces 'Hint revealed. Check below.'

## What NOT to change
- Layer progression logic (3 layers, sequential)
- Auto-rescue threshold (3 attempts -- correct per desirable difficulty research)
- Feedback copy ('Off target. Check the hint below.')
- Any other hint behavior

## Scope
- exam.html hint button aria-expanded attribute (1 attribute add/toggle)
- exam.html triggerRescue() function (1 aria-live announcement)

## Priority: Low (P3)
These are accessibility enhancements, not failures. Screen reader UX improvement only.

## Related
- sw-04: Hint reveal state machine (this spec)
- .design-system.md Section 25 (UX workflow checklist)
- da-12: Keyboard navigation audit (PASS with gaps -- hint layers lack aria-expanded, noted)
